facts.statement: The entry reads PNG information and image rows, then explicitly calls png_read_end with its end_info_ptr. Earlier returns or libpng errors can prevent that call.

The fuzzer supplies the PNG bytes. The entry rejects inputs shorter than eight bytes or with a mismatched signature, then supplies the remaining bytes through a read callback that raises a libpng error if a read exceeds them.

evidence.dependency_reason: The callback defines how supplied bytes are consumed.
These lines install the callback and mark the signature as consumed.

facts.statement: The supplied recipe disables STDIO, WARNING, and WRITE options in pnglibconf.dfa, runs configure, builds libpng16.la, and links the fuzzer against the resulting static library and zlib. It does not itself establish the effective compressed-text feature definitions.
A claim that the old harness has no png_read_end call is refuted by its explicit call after the row loops.

The complete old harness contains no explicit zTXt metadata getter or assertion. Its png_read_end call could still exercise source handling of such metadata; that depends on the source dispatch and effective configuration.
The supplied source excerpt for change g0002 contains only a comment about uninitialized values. It establishes no zTXt or png_read_end behavior.

This continuation supplies no numbered png_handle_zTXt or png_decompress_chunk body establishing the frozen decompression consequence.
The effective PNG_READ_COMPRESSED_TEXT_SUPPORTED and PNG_READ_zTXt_SUPPORTED settings under the supplied build recipe are not established by numbered source evidence.
